bullets: Summer sleeping pad for cats and dogs.
Listed by the maker as waterproof, so wet paws and small spills are easier to clean up.
Made of cloth, a simple pad for many spots around the house.
Size XS in four colors, for cats and dogs.
Lightweight at about 60 g, easy to move between rooms.
copy.description: Looking for a simple summer nap spot for your pet? This summer sleeping mat gives your cat or dog a spot of their own. It is a sleeping pad made of cloth, which the maker lists as waterproof, so wet paws and small spills are easier to clean up. It is made for both cats and dogs, which makes it a practical pick for a home with more than one kind of pet. Set it on the floor, a bed, or in a crate where your pet already likes to lie, and see whether they settle in. It is a simple, no-fuss addition to the places your pet already rests. The maker does not list exact dimensions, so check that it suits your pet before you order.

faq.a: It is sold in size XS in four colors (blue, coffee, grey, pink). The maker does not list exact dimensions.
It is made of cloth and the maker lists it as waterproof. The maker does not state a temperature rating.
Estimate: 5–11 days to the US after 1–3 days of processing. Ships from China.
